# Kourovka Problem 5.29 (free subgroups generated by some of the generators)

The proposition that for every presentation $\langle x_1, \dots, x_m \mid r_1, \dots, r_n \rangle$ with $n \le m$, some $m - n$ of the generators $x_i$ freely generate a free subgroup: there is a set $S$ of $m - n$ indices such that the homomorphism from the free group on $S$ sending each $i$ to the image of $x_i$ is injective.

Source: E. I. Khukhro and V. D. Mazurov (eds.), Unsolved Problems in Group Theory: The Kourovka Notebook, 21st issue, arXiv:1401.0300v49 (2026), Archive of Solved Problems, Problem 5.29 (R. C. Lyndon).
